articles.summary: Women are done being quiet about perimenopause. While perimenopause has become less stigmatized in culture and media, most women are navigating the transition without the information or support they need. Hers can help. Hear from Jessica Shepherd, MD, MBA, FACOG, and Chief Medical Officer of Hers.
articles.title: Bridging the Perimenopause Information Gap
